name: MIN-MEX Cut
justification: Clean observation that the answer is only 0/1/2, one-liner to implement, crisp verdicts.
solution_sketch: MEX of a piece is 0 (no zeros), 1 (zeros only) or 2 (both). If no '0' answer 0; if all zeros form one contiguous block cut it out for 1; otherwise take the whole string for 2 (two zero-blocks force >=2).
